name: omnibridge/symfony
description: The Symfony host of omnisense/omnibridge's contracts (urls, translations, access, sessions, tokens, environment) - adapters over Symfony's router, translator, security and kernel, their container wiring and OmnibridgeBundle - and the framework packages omnisense/omnibase no longer requires. A Symfony site requires it beside the core.

suggest.omnibridge/doctrine: omnibase's persistence on Doctrine's ORM (base.persistence: doctrine, the default where it is installed), with doctrine/doctrine-bundle and symfony/doctrine-bridge: Doctrine's wiring - the entity manager's listeners and filters, the DBAL types, the Doctrine-named commands (doctrine:schema:charset, doctrine:database:import...) - is registered only where it is installed (Persistences::isInstalled('doctrine'), plan "omnibase agnostic", step B3); omnibridge/eloquent is the other persistence
suggest.doctrine/doctrine-bundle: Doctrine's entity manager and connection as Symfony services, for omnibridge/doctrine (the persistence on Doctrine) and the packages written on DoctrineBundle (omnibase/admin's EasyAdmin, API Platform's doctrine-orm)
suggest.symfony/doctrine-bridge: The security provider `entity:` and the form type EntityType on Doctrine, for omnibridge/doctrine; on omnibridge/eloquent, the users' provider is Base\Repository\Users
suggest.omnisense/omnibase: Omnibridge\Symfony\Omnibase\: omnibase's Symfony form layer, moved from the core (^6.0: no former Base\ name any more): the form types, extensions, FormFactory, FormProxy, FormProcessor
suggest.omniauth/google: Google sign-in through Omnibridge\Symfony\Auth\ (omniauth.yaml: oauth.providers.google; its GoogleFactory is registered when it is installed)
suggest.omniauth/otp: Authenticator applications through Omnibridge\Symfony\Auth\ (omniauth.yaml: totp; totp.secret_key seals the secrets at rest), formerly omniauth/totp
suggest.omniauth/webauthn: Passkeys through Omnibridge\Symfony\Auth\ (omniauth.yaml: passkey), formerly omniauth/passkey
suggest.omnisense/omniauth: Omnibridge\Symfony\Auth\: one authenticator over omniauth for every way of signing in (password, sign-in link, e-mailed code, backup codes, trusted devices, identity providers - omniauth's Omniauth\OAuth\, each provider a package of its own), its second factor's token and page, its routes; config/packages/omniauth.yaml (nothing of Auth\ without it)
suggest.omnisense/omnimap: Omnibridge\Symfony\Map\: maps through omnimap (config/packages/omnimap.yaml) - its providers over the application's HTTP client and cache pool, the map cache over a storage service of the application's, the cache's routes (type "omnimap") and controller, omnibridge/twig's MapExtension (omnimap(), omnimap_export(), omnimap_suppress()); omnimap/google, omnimap/openstreetmap and omnimap/maplibre registered when installed
suggest.omnibridge/static: Static\BuildCommand: bin/console omnibridge:static:build, omnibridge/static's export of the site a static.php declares, rendered by this kernel
suggest.omnisense/omnidrive: Omnidrive\Drives: the storages of league/flysystem-bundle's configuration (the services tagged flysystem.storage) as omnidrive's drives, by their names
suggest.symfony/monolog-bundle: Monolog's handlers and channels, MonologBundle registered by the application (^3.8|^4.0): omnibase's services log through psr/log's LoggerInterface, whatever answers it, and none needs MonologBundle's services with omnisense/omnibase 5.0 (SpamChecker makes monolog.http_client's client itself where it is not there); with it, the demo environment's messages go to the channel `demo`
suggest.symfony/asset: RouterUrls::asset() through the application's asset packages (assets.packages); without it, the path as it is
suggest.omnisense/contracts: Omnibridge\Symfony\Policy\RateLimiter: omnisense/contracts' RateLimiterInterface (the usage policies' limits and waits of the omni families' providers) over symfony/rate-limiter, with it
suggest.symfony/rate-limiter: Omnibridge\Symfony\Policy\RateLimiter: a provider policy's limits counted by Symfony's rate limiter, each a fixed window over the application's storage (a CacheStorage on a shared pool: every process counts together), with omnisense/contracts; symfony/lock keeps two processes from counting one window at once
